string.text: Man, I'm starving. Haven't had a proper meal in ages.
I could eat a whole boar right now, I swear.
I'm so hungry right now I could settle for some snork meat.
Ugh, I'm starving.
Finally ate something decent. Feeling a lot better.
Belly's full for once. Life's not so bad.
Can barely keep my eyes open. Need to sleep badly.
Running on fumes here. Can't wait to get some shut-eye.
Too tired to think straight.
Finally feeling rested up.
Slept well for once.
Slept like a rock. Didn't think that was possible out here.
Really just need a good breather.
I've been going nonstop, need to chill for a bit.
Everything aches. Hope I don't need to go anywhere for a while.
Took a breather finally. Muscles don't hate me anymore.
Glad we stopped when we did. Feeling a lot more like myself.
Good to just sit around for a bit. Almost forgot what that felt like.
Starting to talk to myself out there.
Been alone with my thoughts too long. Zone messes with your head when it's quiet.
It's been too long since I've had a real conversation. Almost forgot how.
No longer feeling so alone.
Feels good to take it easy and shoot the breeze for once.
Actually had some good conversation lately.
Running low on everything. Hope I can scrounge some supplies soon.
Down to scraps. Can't keep operating like this.
Gonna need to pick up some supplies soon.
Finally topped off my gear. Nice to have a full kit again.
Got resupplied. Feels good not to be counting bullets for once.
Stocked up properly. Should be set for a while now.
Completely broke. Need to find a job or start scavenging something.
Pockets are empty. Gotta find some cash soon.
Been a long time since I've seen any rubles.
Can finally breathe easy after coming into some cash.
Finally got some rubles. Things aren't so bad when you're not completely broke.
Sitting pretty for once. Now let's see how long it lasts.
